Dear Ms. Valdez,

Receiving your dispute letter regarding the account referenced above, we acknowledge your concerns regarding the alleged invasion of your privacy and the sharing of account information with a household member. We understand that you have previously requested that we not contact your home regarding this account.

We are investigating your dispute and will provide you with a validation of the debt as requested. The current balance on the account is $292.53. According to our records, the original creditor of this account is Heartland Savings Bank, and the charge-off date was July 20, 2022. The last payment received on this account was on June 21, 2023.

As per the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and South Dakota state law, we are required to provide you with a validation of the debt. We will send you a written notice within the next 30 days, which will include the amount of the debt, the name of the creditor, and a statement that unless you dispute the validity of this debt within 30 days after receiving the notice, we will assume the debt to be valid.

Please note that you have the right to dispute the debt further if you believe it is inaccurate or invalid. If you wish to dispute the debt, please respond to this letter within 30 days.

Sincerely,
